verdict.rationale: Plausible's Stats API is explicitly versioned: the documented endpoint is /api/v2/query, which implies a version scheme. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or migration guidance for older versions, so only half the story is shown. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset timelines, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex stats queries in the POST request body and returns the metrics as JSON.
Plausible Stats API is a read-only HTTP interface for viewing historical and real-time stats.
